en.title: Game of Thrones' Tormund Giantsbane Finds True Love in New Rom-Com
en.summary: Kristofer Hivju, beloved for his role as Tormund in 'Game of Thrones,' is stepping away from icy landscapes to embrace the warmth of a romantic comedy. He's set to star in the upcoming Swedish-Croatian film 'True Love' from acclaimed author-turned-director Martina Haag.
en.body:
For many, **Kristofer Hivju** will forever be linked to the roaring firelight and harsh winters of Westeros as the indomitable Tormund Giantsbane. His portrayal of the loyal, boisterous, and surprisingly tender-hearted Wildling chieftain left an indelible mark on the global phenomenon that is **‘Game of Thrones’**. But Hivju’s talents extend far beyond the battlefield and the Wall, and his next project promises to showcase a completely different side of his acting prowess.

He is slated to star in **‘True Love’** (working title), a new Swedish-Croatian romantic comedy. This film marks the directorial debut of **Martina Haag**, a celebrated Swedish author and screenwriter known for her best-selling novels and her previous work, **‘Little Did I Know’**. Haag's transition from page to screen for this project brings a fresh perspective to the rom-com landscape, blending her established storytelling sensibility with the visual medium. Hivju will be joined on screen by **Frida Hallgren**, an actress recognized for her role in the Oscar-nominated Swedish drama **‘As It Is in Heaven’**. The pairing of Hivju and Hallgren, both respected performers in their own right, suggests a compelling on-screen dynamic for this new romantic narrative.

## A New Direction for a Familiar Face

The announcement of Hivju's involvement in a rom-com might come as a surprise to fans who primarily associate him with his rugged, action-oriented roles, including his appearances in the **‘Beck’** film series and the recent **‘Red One’**. However, this pivot is a testament to the versatility of actors who can inhabit a wide range of characters. Haag’s directorial vision, coupled with Hivju’s undeniable charisma, could lead to a rom-com that offers both humor and genuine emotional depth, moving beyond typical genre conventions. The project, currently in pre-production under SF Studios, is set to be presented to potential partners at an upcoming pitch event, signaling its readiness to move into full production.

## What This Means for Fans

For the passionate global fanbase of **‘Game of Thrones’** and Hivju’s broader filmography, this news offers an exciting opportunity to see the actor in an entirely new light. It’s a chance to witness his expressive capabilities applied to the nuances of romantic comedy, a genre that thrives on relatable characters and heartfelt moments. The anticipation builds around how Hivju’s inherent warmth and commanding presence will translate into a romantic lead, and how his chemistry with Hallgren will unfold. This venture into a different genre also highlights the evolving careers of actors who have become synonymous with major franchises, demonstrating their desire to explore diverse storytelling avenues and connect with audiences on different emotional frequencies.

## What's Next

With **‘True Love’** currently in pre-production, details regarding its filming schedule and a definitive release date are expected to be announced as the project progresses. Fans will be eager to follow the development of this promising romantic comedy and discover when they can catch **Kristofer Hivju** in his charming new role.
